'''''Koh-Lanta: Panama''''' was the fourth season of the [[France|French]] version of [[Survivor (TV series)|''Survivor'']], ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. Like season three, this season was held in [[Panama]] but in the archipelago of Las Perlas.<ref>{{Cite web |title=France - Télévision. "Koh-Lanta" : ils sont de chez nous, vous les avez vus à la télé |url=https://www.bienpublic.com/societe/2020/03/28/koh-lanta-ils-sont-de-chez-nous-vous-les-avez-vus-a-la-tele |access-date=2023-11-21 |website=www.bienpublic.com |language=FR-fr}}</ref> It was broadcast [[TF1]] from Friday July 2, 2004 to Tuesday August 31, 2004. This season the contestants were initially divided into two tribes known as Chapera and Mogo, both of which consisted of eight contestants of the same gender.<ref>{{Citation|title=Real TV France: "''Koh-Lanta 4'' News"|url=http://www.realtv-fr.net/realtv_27.htm|access-date=2023-11-19|language=fr|archive-date=2004-10-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023214759/http://www.realtv-fr.net/realtv_27.htm|url-status=bot: unknown}}</ref> Following a tribal swap on day eight many contestants found themselves living on new tribes. Due to two evacuations that occurred this season, both Linda and Sophie returned to the game following their initial eliminations.

The winner of this season of ''Koh-Lanta'' was Philippe Bordier, who took home the prize of €100,000.

===Future appearances===
* Catherine Ehret-Mader, Romuald Lafite, and Philippe Bordier returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Retour des Héros]]'', which Lafite won.
* Linda Alario returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Choc des Héros]]''.
